reviewSamples.author: Lobna Elakkawi
reviewSamples.text: Amine change the shower flooring in the master bathroom, change sink stoppers and fixed electric outlets. Made the job easy, he finished the job on time without delays. …

reviewSamples.author: Juliana
reviewSamples.text: Amine did a great job in my new house. I needed someone to open the drywall on the shower wall to install a niche and it's perfect. No mess! Also he did help us with other installations. He is very dedicated and responsible!

reviewSamples.author: Rhonda Castagna
reviewSamples.text: Thank you Amine! He did an amazing job installing the "bit complicated" fan in the laundry room, and helping to program the fixture in the app! He also replaced the lighting for the bathrooms. He was prompt, polite & fairly priced. Will definitely be calling for his services again!

reviewSamples.author: Bill Souder Brian Callaghan
reviewSamples.text: Amine has been to my home several times for handyman repairs and installation of various items. He is professional, very reliable, and on time. He provides a good value for the work that he performs. He also has great ideas on placement of items for the best use.

reviewSamples.author: Nikki
reviewSamples.text: Amine was professional, courteous and prompt. We had him install 3 lights and 2 ceiling fans. He went above and beyond by making sure fans were programmed and even helped fix a light that was damaged upon delivery. He was great and highly recommend him!

notes: Mobile/service-area handyman business (no public street address on Google Maps; pin sits a few miles inland from downtown Pompano Beach, near the Margate/North Lauderdale area, consistent with a mobile service business without a storefront). Technician named in every review: Amine. Also found listed on Thumbtack as 'Instant Handyman' (Fort Lauderdale/Broward service area), same technician name, confirming identity. No own website, no public email, no Instagram/Facebook found.
